Monthly return regarding transfer of Past Accumulation on cancellation of

Sir, 
Please refer to this office letter No.Invest.I/6/Confir./Accep.With/46/2014-15/8409 
dated 08-08-2017 vide which it was requested to submit the monthly return regarding transfer 
of past accumulation on cancellation of exemption through e-mail. 
In this regard, now it has been observed that some Regional Offices are sending their 
monthly return regarding transfer of Past Accumulation on cancellation of exemption to Head 
Office by post in physical mode and some Regional Offices are not sending the said returns on 
regular basis by any mode. 
All RPFCs In-charge are again instructed to send their report 
(including NIL) in soft copy to Head Office at the below mentioned email a9dress on regular 
basis:-
Email ID so.inv@epfindia.gov.in 
With CC to : ac.invl@eofindia.qov.in, rc.investment@epfindia.qov.in , 
Yours faithfully
